ruling: KEYED-OBJECT is canonical contract. Frontend adapts.
justification: The macro-indicators Go service (Phase-2 CLOSED pilot) defines signals as a typed struct `SignalResult` with 6 named fields serialised to a keyed JSON object by encoding/json. This is the sole DTO definition in the codebase (dtos.go). No mcp-server consumer iterates signals — the MCP tool passes the raw blob as text; macroIndicatorRefreshJob never reads signals. The frontend array expectation (MacroSignal[]) predates the Go rewrite and was never updated in lockstep. Reverting macro to an array would reopen a CLOSED pilot, modify a Go DTO + serializer, rebuild the macro container, and risk breaking cowork consumers. The frontend is the lone stale consumer and the correct fix site.
